def smelt_cell(res):
    p = nearest(res)
    bb = BuildingBox(width=3, height=3+3+1+1)
    c = nearest_buildable(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, bb, p)
    lt = c.left_top
    move_to(lt)
    drill = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=Position(x=lt.x+1.5, y=lt.y+1.5), direction=Direction.DOWN)
    fur = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, drill.position, direction=Direction.DOWN, spacing=0)
    ins = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.Inserter, fur.position, direction=Direction.DOWN, spacing=0)
    print(res[0], 'drill', drill.position, 'drop', drill.drop_position, 'fur', fur.position, 'ins', ins.position, ins.direction, 'pick', ins.pickup_position, 'drop', ins.drop_position)
    return drill, fur, ins
